transitions.summary: Ceaseless turning fails to establish dignity or livelihood; when the social center loses substance, leaders and cultivators alike receive no sustaining return.
Wheels, horses, and companions move as one across difficult ground, while the crane remains safely sheltered; coordinated effort makes the demanding route workable.
Scorching pressure and scattering winds prevent the rain from gathering, so persistence cannot secure relief and the movement turns back toward shelter.
A tiger’s sudden presence scatters the herds and closes the road, leaving forward movement trapped within a narrow southern passage.
A royal circuit aligned with the autumn sky distributes care across the land, linking timely authority with public calm and material security.
An old dwelling is already settled and complete; without surplus for renovation, its adequacy still allows it to become a contented home.
A journey through a difficult gate secures standing and resources, receives distant favor, and completes its arc in a restorative return home.
A capable pair forms an ordered household whose mutual fitness supports continuity, well-being, and benefits that extend beyond the immediate union.
Careless joking across a boundary becomes humiliation and punishment; an apparently minor offense awakens a stronger adversary and seeds later disaster.
Bright perception and an expansive bearing meet a triple arrival of fortunate signs, portraying benefits carried together toward a receptive center.
After seeking what it needs through the day, the small bird returns at evening and finds unforced happiness within its familiar shelter.
Directional emblems lead and carry the traveler through the celestial gate, where accumulated movement culminates in an audience with discerning authority.
A well-timed market lets each participant convert what they hold into what they value, creating shared satisfaction through reciprocal exchange.
The pursuit produces more than expected and is welcomed with joy, yet an obscure injury remains above, tempering an easy victory with caution.
Covered eyes and absent lights lead into a formal chamber filled with ritual objects, where outward dignity accompanies an inability to see clearly.
As streams naturally gather in the sea, portable wealth is deliberately exchanged for nourishment, turning possession into something immediately useful.
A properly prepared offering and a southern inspection bring ruler and respondents into reciprocal accord, allowing the encounter to benefit both sides.
Planting at the fitting time establishes durable roots; balanced conditions then support a cycle of growth without disruptive reversal.
Darkness reaches fullness and gives way to illumination, but the achievement lacks endurance; an unworthy substitute soon occupies the central seat.
Precious court objects accompany the image of impoverished counselors raised into service, suggesting that overlooked capacity can find a fitting public role.
Trust dissolves across family, friendship, and partnership, leaving hesitant movement and the dejection of one who no longer feels securely received.
Exemplary rulers inhabit the household’s sacred corner, making quiet centrality a source of protection for both living beings and the wider polity.
Two birds return together toward sustenance but are wounded while crossing concealment, turning shared movement into a scene of mutual vulnerability and grief.
Broken containers lie crushed and pierced in the road; once the capacity to hold value is destroyed, former treasures can no longer be gathered.
A position as steady as a great mountain receives abundant support; surrounding predators remain present, yet cannot disturb the established foundation.
Extra hands create neither nourishment nor usefulness; multiplication without coordination becomes incapacity, and every form of practical benefit withdraws.
An exhausted carrier meets severe weather on a mountain ascent, making retreat from the midpoint more coherent than forcing a closed route.
Endless argument and opposing forces turn a familiar wind destructive, splitting the household and abandoning its most dependent relationships.
A border ruler visits the greater court, receives ceremonial hospitality, and returns home in peace after the relationship is ritually acknowledged.
Massive barriers close every direction, so the wish to advance yields to a return home rather than a futile contest with the terrain.
Contaminating ground damages both body and reputation, while evenly balanced opponents spend themselves without resolution and share the resulting loss.
Quiet conduct follows an ethically ordered path and avoids needless error, allowing favorable conditions to ripen without agitation.
Threats appear on every side, yet refusing premature movement preserves wholeness; remaining within known bounds becomes the available form of protection.
Carefully prepared offerings express reverence and establish continuity between present devotion and future generations, though the appended image warns that learning can still be delayed.
A grand journey reaches an ancient but depleted place where earth has hardened and animals cannot graze, leaving movement without replenishment.
Accumulated bodily affliction drains vitality until even leaving the house is beyond reach, converting outward power into forced confinement.
Small creatures hide in mud after leaving open water, while narrow passages and distant poles intensify deprivation; concealment protects little when movement remains constrained.
The culture hero’s extraordinary perception gives form to the eight figures and aligns humane influence with the time, linking insight, pattern, and enduring benefit.
Like the pole star within its palace, ordered appearance and benevolent power establish a stable center; unsuitable tools, however, cannot realize demanding work.
Winter fruiting signals disturbed seasonality as banditry spreads and governance fails, joining natural irregularity with persistent political disorder.
Damaged and misaligned sight cannot identify what stands only a few paces away, making proximity useless where perception itself is impaired.
Hungry animals crowd around an empty or inaccessible source, while a panicked bird barely escapes; need, scarcity, and misdirected force compound one another.
A well-cared-for horse and wagon attract a buyer, but the exchange remains sound only if the offered value is sufficient to prevent regret.
Complete civic order keeps the shuttle straight across the whole realm, allowing capable administration to connect distant regions in peace.
A tree fruits beyond its ordinary cycle as migrating birds rise and settle; cultivated wisdom extends its benefit toward lands at the margins.
A marquis pauses at the river and marks passing days while separated from his ruler, holding political attachment steady across distance and delay.
Food ripens at the center of the plain and many companions are invited to partake, turning patient completion into collective fulfillment.
A stronger bird occupies a nest another built, but physical advantage lacks moral support; possession gained through displacement remains without heaven’s assistance.
